headline: Fiesta and the first playoff round share April, the city's loudest month
summary: Engagement here is civic, and it peaks from April through June, when the playoffs overlap Fiesta and Cinco de Mayo. After the 2026 West title and the Finals loss to the Knicks, the baseline sits far above the rebuild years. The first product window runs from the Oct 20 opener against OKC to the Dec 25 rematch at the Knicks. In February the city turns to rodeo and western wear.

insights.title: Fiesta and the playoffs collide in April
insights.detail: Fiesta San Antonio runs about ten days in the second half of April and lands on the first playoff rounds. Its events include Battle of Flowers, Fiesta Flambeau and NIOSA, and Fiesta medal culture is everywhere. Medals, papel picado colors and cascarones are the local visual language of that fortnight.
insights.implication: Drop a Fiesta-stripe or Fiesta-palette playoff capsule in early April, not at the City Edition launch. Fans can wear it to watch parties and parades. Credit the local artists.

insights.title: February belongs to the Rodeo
insights.detail: The San Antonio Stock Show and Rodeo fills most of February around the Frost Bank Center, and the Spurs have long scheduled a multi-game Rodeo Road Trip away from home. Western wear (hats, boots, Wranglers) is the city's top retail category that month.
insights.implication: Fan engagement dips at home in February, but a Spurs-in-western-wear crossover is a one-month opportunity. Time a silver-and-black western shirt, trucker or belt buckle piece to rodeo opening.

insights.title: Silver and black is worn all year
insights.detail: Spurs gear gets worn every month, including by military families at Fort Sam Houston, Lackland and Randolph, so baseline retail doesn't collapse in summer. Dips come from 100-degree heat and the Texas high-school football and Cowboys fall calendar, not from team indifference.
insights.implication: Keep core Association and Icon product in stock all year, and save limited drops for the peaks. A Military Appreciation tie-in is credible and local.

insights.title: 2026-27 is a title-chase season with a built-in Knicks story
insights.detail: The Spurs open at home Oct 20 against OKC, a West finals rematch on NBC and Peacock. They play the Knicks at Madison Square Garden on Christmas Day at noon ET, another Finals rematch, and host the Knicks Mar 7. Expectations are title co-favorite.
insights.implication: Christmas and Mar 7 are national-attention spikes for a Wembanyama-led product story. Hold the stars-and-hero graphics for those windows.

insights.title: Fall is the season of Muertos and the NBA Cup
insights.detail: Late October through early November pairs the season start with Dia de los Muertos in the West Side and Southtown (altars, ofrendas, calaveras). NBA Cup group play starts too, including Lakers at Spurs on Oct 30. The Fiesta-stripe City Edition uniform returns this season after its November 2025 debut.
insights.implication: Keep sacred Muertos imagery out of commerce unless community partners are involved. Use Fiesta color and papel picado craft cues instead, and credit local artists.

insights.title: Project Marvel shapes sentiment
insights.detail: The planned downtown arena is a roughly $1.3B project within a larger district, and it is at least five years out. The team ran a summer 2026 community listening tour and is seeking lease amendments at the Frost Bank Center. Fans are proud of the team but sensitive about public money and neighborhoods.
insights.implication: Skip downtown-arena and Frost Bank Center nostalgia product until the story settles. Frame it around the East Side and West Side communities, not the skyline.

productHooks: Fiesta playoff capsule in early April: warm-up, tee and hat in the City Edition stripe palette, plus pin sets, with credit to local artists.
February rodeo capsule: a black-and-silver western-yoke shirt and hat, sold in San Antonio retail and the Frost Bank Center store.
Opening-night and Christmas drops tied to Wembanyama and the Knicks rematch, with a Dec 25 Finals-rematch graphic tee.
Military Appreciation night apparel and hats, sold through local base exchanges and the arena.

watchouts: Dia de los Muertos is a religious and family observance. Don't commercialize ofrenda imagery without community partners.
Local organizations license Fiesta medals and the Fiesta brand. Confirm rights before using the name or medal designs.
Project Marvel and lease politics are sensitive. Avoid downtown-arena and skyline product.
Skip generic Alamo and cowboy tropes. Use Fiesta, Rodeo and Tejano specifics.
Military references need the right branch licensing and care.
